title: Explicit normalized finite Kummer comparison
statement: For prime l, finite E/Q_l, finite level n, e:X≅P¹_S, l invertible on S, and section-normalized coefficient coordinates c from [def-sp-p1-coefficient-coordinates], define the finite source and shifted-line coordinates by composing c.unit and c.line with nuSingle, the exact shift comparison, and inverse ordinary pullback coordinates from [sk-lem-geo-p1-cohomology] and [lem-sfb-finite-p1-coefficient-adjunction-coordinates]. The canonical finiteP1KummerCoordinate for tower Chern data cX is evaluation followed by this line coordinate. Define finiteP1OrdinaryKummerArrow by conjugating the ordinary positive etale Kummer class by the finite source and line coordinates. Its endpoints are [def-sfb-finite-kummer-boundary-equation]. The ordinary arrow does not use the tower Chern class or its normalization. Every object and isomorphism is a concrete composite, without choice from an existence theorem.
